QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Town Beautification
QuestInfo.0: #p9400221# has called for you. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1:
#p9400221# feels the Land of Contemplation is too unfriendly for #p9400223# to stay.\r\nBring trees into the town to brighten the place up for #p9400223#.

Gather #e#t4034998# and place it gently at the location marked by #p9400221#.
QuestInfo.2: You moved the tree inside the town in the Land of Contemplation for #p9400223#.\r\nPreviously, the place was kept bare so no one bumped into things on their meditative walks, but #p9400223#'s arrival has really brought things to life.
